A [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual was the '''adoptive mother''' of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaden Korr]]. His only memory of her was the fruity scent of her [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. The woman died in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] accident when Korr was very young.
